summary: ai-sdlc-executor-aisdlc-1388 is over its context threshold but its handoff is unproven; it was not restarted

body: The rotation grace lapsed without a new RESUME HERE block (the handoff file does not exist). Ask the session to write its handoff, or restart it with cli-hierarchy restart --force, which loses its unrecorded state.
